subject: biology
title: Interactive templates (test)
key_idea: A test note that uses each self-test template once.

diagram.alt: Tap a cell structure to learn its job, then test yourself.
diagram.prompt: Parts of an animal and plant cell

parts.name: Nucleus
parts.detail: Contains the genetic material, which controls the activities of the cell.

parts.name: Cytoplasm
parts.detail: A jelly-like liquid where most chemical reactions happen.

parts.name: Cell membrane
parts.detail: Controls which substances pass in and out of the cell.

parts.name: Mitochondria
parts.detail: Where aerobic respiration happens, releasing energy.

parts.name: Chloroplasts
parts.detail: Absorb light for photosynthesis. Found in plant cells only.

parts.name: Cell wall
parts.detail: Made of cellulose. Strengthens the cell. Found in plant cells only.

diagram.alt: Put the stages of the cell cycle in order.
diagram.prompt: Put the cell cycle in order
steps: The cell grows and makes more ribosomes and mitochondria
One set of chromosomes is pulled to each end of the cell
The cytoplasm and cell membrane divide
